ConfigurationGuide: Tracked in git and MUST NOT contain secrets: every secret-shaped value here is an empty string. Jwt/RefreshToken/Identity/EmailConfirmation/PasswordReset/EmailChange are configured here because AddIdentityModule validates them at startup, and this host composes that module for two things: IRefreshTokenMaintenanceService's adapter, and — the one that decides it — IUserProfilesService, which EmailReminderNotifier needs to find the address a due reminder is rung at. This host never authenticates anybody either way. Email is configured here for a reason of its own, one module over: AddEmailModule validates it at startup because IReminderNotifier's mail adapter lives there, even though this host sends no confirmation mail of its own. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
